limitations: R7.1 is INVALID under the frozen validator, despite low-level playback and known cleanup passing. Its numerical deltas are descriptive only.
A validator defect assumed one SourceBuffer per MP4 track; the real worker emits one combined-codec initData item. No retrospective qualification or threshold changes.
Python policy fixtures had one track each; Angular checks verified actual A/V playback and balance without applying this Python expectation. The regression gap remains for the next campaign.
N=1 independent browser per measured condition; six ABC cycles are not independent repetitions.
The user authorized regenerated MP4 bytes; parameters match R6 but plaintext hashes differ, preventing strict quantitative historical comparison.
The production service consumed two chunks per fixture within the 1.5-second protocol; the control consumed three. Equal input corpus does not mean equal bytes processed.
The common empty Angular root and real crypto dependency startup are excluded from video deltas by stabilization and baseline sampling.
Control uses worker Blob URLs; production service uses genuine bundled worker URLs. These schemes belong to the service composite boundary.
Control/service are explicitly muted; the original player is unmuted and retains its native 500ms canplay interval. Component mode was checked functionally before freeze but never measured.
Known ownership counters and window-keydown unit checks do not cover every native allocation, GPU resource or listener. Private commit is not VRAM.
No leak, security defect, absence of growth or causal attribution to the real service/component is established.
